objects.name: Analytic 2270
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a host process making sequential Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol reads with output piped to a local staging file, from a process not associated with a recognized Human-Machine Interface (HMI) or historian tool. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=11 where an unrecognized process creates a staging/output file after bulk ICS data access activity
